schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The librarian: owner of the graph trees — db_domain's first real tenant — and, when its face is whole, a chatbot that is learning always and summarizing when asked. v0 is the SPINE (trees.py): a provenance-gated deposit door (a node is content + vector + provenance + standing; the untraceable never lands; every node is born a hypothesis) and proximity walks whose edges are DERIVED from the vectors at walk time, never stored — 'the embedding IS the path through the graph trees.' v0.1 adds THE CORE LOOP (loop.py): always the graph first; when the walk's best cosine misses RESOLUTION_FLOOR, the LLM is asked for NODES (never the answer), they deposit through the same provenance gate, and the ORIGINAL question resubmits — the proof the backfill worked is that structure now resolves it. The backfill-cache livelock is fixed as physics at that junction: the prompt carries tree_state's digest (same question + changed graph = different cache key) and a round depositing nothing fresh terminates loudly as no_progress. Live wiring: `python3 -m cairn.librarian.live [query|loop]` (both verbs through inference_domain, metered and cached; trees.py and loop.py are import-pure and the proofs pin it).
why: Akien, 2026-07-27, verbatim: 'the current goal is the librarian as chat bot, learning, and summarizing. learning always and summarizing when asked' ... 'And he'll already be ready to answer them immediately. This is part of orienting, for anything externally facing.' The core loop he named 'very simple' (2026-07-22): a query resolves by traversing the trees — cheap, no inference; on a MISS the LLM supplies the NODES that let the graph resolve, never the answer; the answer always comes from structure, so re-asking is a graph walk. That is Law 1 as a runtime mechanism, and this store is the structure it runs on. The deposit door's provenance gate is the extractor's founding defect carried one layer down: a fabricated attribution in a draft is a bad day; in a graph node it is a permanent resident.
invoke: import: `from cairn.librarian.trees import LibrarianDevice, deposit, nearest, neighbors` and `from cairn.librarian.loop import resolve_query`. Prove: `python3 cairn/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees.py` and `python3 cairn/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_loop.py` (exit 0 = green; need the one-time DB provisioning, no host). Live: `python3 -m cairn.librarian.live [query]` (the founding demo; embeds via nomic-embed-text) and `python3 -m cairn.librarian.live loop [question]` (the core loop; dual seam — nomic-embed-text embeds, qwen2.5:7b drafts nodes, the model stamped on each request so it rides the cache key).
node_class: device — owner of the graph trees; fires per deposit/walk request, never on a clock. The library room (instance-space, RATIFIED address ~/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/library/) is its shelf space — a later stone, not this one.
entry: FRESH build. UU had a graph-tree embeddings generator that self-trained via API calls — a graft candidate deliberately NOT carried into v0 (its mechanism may cross later the way isolation.py did; design re-authored). What v0 reuses is Cairn's own: db_domain's owner-gate as the write physics, inference_domain's embed seam as the vector source, the extractor's judged-at-the-door discipline.
state_and_history: compiled to state.json (projected window) + history.json (append-only voyage) beside this charter — the charter-state-history split.
how_it_learns: Three loops, staged. (1) BUILT NOW, the substrate: every deposit is a learned fact taking structural residence — the graph IS the memory, and a duplicate deposit writing nothing is Law 1 at the door. (2) FILED, the tenure loop: every node is born standing='hypothesis' (Law 3) and today honestly STAYS there — tenure (does the node keep resolving well?) becomes a measurement when the core loop runs and outcomes accumulate; if nodes still all read 'hypothesis' weeks into live use, that loop never landed and standing is a decoration (the falsifier says so). (3) BUILT NOW, the core loop itself (loop.py): on a MISS the LLM provides nodes, the graph folds them in and the ORIGINAL question re-resolves — learning always, as the face's standing behavior; measured live 2026-07-27 (first crossing: one backfill, one fresh node, then RESOLVED at 0.8568; second crossing: zero backfills, zero inference in the answer path). The librarian is the component whose learning IS its function; 'it doesn't learn' would be a charter violation here, not a valid answer.
filed_edges: (a) RESOLUTION_FLOOR = 0.65 IS AN n=1 GUESS (seeded by the first live walk: right node 0.7473, adjacent 0.6278), returned in every verdict so no caller mistakes it for settled; it tunes against real use. (The loop itself is BUILT — this edge narrowed from 'build the loop' to 'earn the floor'.)

(b) A DUPLICATE DROPS ITS NEW PROVENANCE: corroboration (a second source saying the same thing) is evidence the tenure loop will want; when that loop lands, a duplicate becomes a provenance APPEND, not a discard.
(c) THE TENURE LOOP (standing: hypothesis -> earned) — unbuilt; see how_it_learns (2).

(d) PROXIMITY IS COMPUTED IN PYTHON, O(n) PER WALK — correct now, and every deposit re-reads the tree for its dimension check; pgvector (proximity computed where the vectors live) when a real load pulls it.
(e) TREES-INDEX-INTO-COMMONS GRANTS (private-down default, grant-up explicit) — one table with a tree column today; the grant model opens when a second owner exists.
(f) THE LIBRARY ROOM + SHELVING — the first acquisition job (TheIgorsProject/Akien -> stable citable addresses that provenance can point into); a separate stone.
(g) THE SUMMARIZER (the transducer: dense graph region -> articulated why-carrying prose) and (h) THE CHAT SURFACE (web_server can carry it — unratified read): later stones on this same device.
gates: proof gate — proofs/test_librarian_trees.py (14 teeth) + proofs/test_librarian_loop.py (10 teeth), both under the tester's MEASURED netns seal (the Unix socket crosses the seal — db_domain's documented asymmetry, exercised for real: the DB reachable, the network gone). Durability gate: committed + pushed. Build gate: journaled PROVEME exit inspected.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a deposit without a traceable source LANDS (trees tooth 1 — the founding defect in permanent residence); (2) an edge table appears (the derived-edges claim gone hollow); (3) a dimension mismatch is ANSWERED instead of refused; (4) a non-librarian write lands (Law 6 physics failed through the stack); (5) a duplicate deposit grows the table; (6) a deposit crossing leaves no breadcrumb; (7) trees.py or loop.py grows an import outside its allowlist (a second door); (8) the loop returns a generate answer instead of a walk (the host in the answer path — loop tooth: the answer comes from structure); (9) two backfill prompts for the same question against a CHANGED graph canonicalize to the same cache key (the livelock reopened — loop's livelock tooth pins canonicalize inequality); (10) a no-progress round spins instead of terminating loudly. WRONG-SHAPE SIGNALS: every node still 'hypothesis' weeks into live use (the tenure loop never landed); answers coming from inference when the graph already holds the structure (the core loop bypassed — the device demoted to a vector cache); UNRESOLVED verdicts booked anywhere as savings.
proof: proofs/test_librarian_trees.py — the untraceable refused three ways; vectors physics at both doors; a node lands, round-trips as structure, born a hypothesis; a duplicate writes nothing; dimension mismatch refused both directions; nearest provably in cosine order and an empty tree an honest []; trees do not cross; neighbors derived, self excluded, ghosts refused; no edge table exists; the owner-gate holds through the stack; crossings breadcrumb and reads stay silent; tree_state a pure function of membership; device-hood + Form v0 #2 order; import purity by AST allowlist. proofs/test_librarian_loop.py — resolved-through-structure (no generate call when the graph clears the floor); the miss-backfill-resubmit voyage; the livelock fix pinned at the key (two prompts, changed graph, canonicalize UNEQUAL); the progress gate terminates no_progress; exhaustion honest at max_backfills; refusals ride the verdict whole; the seam refused when absent; the drafted answer never returned; breadcrumbs both verdicts; import purity. Green: both scripts exit 0.
owner: librarian owns librarian_nodes (recorded in db_domain's registry; the owner-gate is the write physics). CC owns the code + proofs. Akien owns the design: the face, the verbs, the parts inventory, the embedding-is-the-path model.
provenance: Cast and built 2026-07-27 on Akien's go ('yes! go go go!'), the first stone of the librarian-as-chatbot chain (tickets/librarian.json -> librarian-graph-trees.json). Its first live walk ranked Akien's own chatbot-goal sentence nearest (0.7473) to a query about the chat interface — the librarian's first real nodes are its own founding design, each carrying provenance into the records it came from. The re-fire was all DUPLICATEs and all cache HITs: host untouched, table untouched, avoided-tokens 955 -> 1165. The core loop (stone 2, 'very good! go go go!') went live 2026-07-27: asked what cosine similarity measures — nothing the founding tree held — it backfilled one node from qwen2.5:7b through the provenance gate and the original question resolved through structure at 0.8568; the second crossing took zero backfills. Law 1 as a runtime mechanism, measured.
